newsitem.title: USA: Chic by H.I.S. unit to list in Germany.
newsitem.headline: Chic by H.I.S. unit to list in Germany.

text.p: Chic by H.I.S. Inc said Monday it will offer 1,920,000 shares of its wholly owned German subsidiary H.I.S. Sportswear AG, representing a 43 percent stake, at 39 marks ($22.58) per share.

It said it has granted the managing underwriter in connection with the offering an option to purchase up to an additional 200,000 shares, representing an additional 4.5 percent stake, to cover over-allotments. The option may be exercised for a period of no more than 30 German bank business days.
Upon consummation of the offering, the German subsidiary's common stock will be listed on the Frankfurt and Munich stock exchanges.

The securities to be sold will not be registered under the Securities Act of 1933 and may not be offered or sold in the United States absent registration or an applicable exemption from registration requirements.
Net proceeds from the sale will be used to repay debt and for general corporate purposes.
Chic designs, manufactures and markets moderately priced, cotton denim jeans, casual pants and shorts.
